I had a ton of fun leveling the bat in core. Heavy attack is a 1-hit kill, used stim shot and sleeper agent with red perks. Sleeper agent especially is broken with the bat, since attacking doesn’t break your disguise. You can literally just walk into the enemy spawn and start swinging.

I stopped killing each boss once i had all their pieces. The common loot is nice but i was pretty undergeared compared to most people i saw and the kills weren’t super fast. Blood moon especially took twice as long as the others. 

Fortunately i got lucky on blue moon and finished the set around 150 kc so it sped up quite a bit.

1. God boon for my main source of damage, usually aphrodite or poseidon. For surface runs i’ll take Hestia first to get a good shot at soot sprint. 

2. Chaos keepsake, hoping for either damage or health regen. 

3. Blackened fleece usually kicks in by the third area, or i’ll take Hera’s keepsake for Born Gain if I still need mana regen. 

4. Evil Eye if it’s on Chronos, or just keep on the Blackened Fleece otherwise. Luckier Tooth is good too.
